products.name: Flux Encoder
products.description: Queue, inspect and encode media with hardware-aware FFmpeg profiles.

entries: Synchronized package and suite metadata for the v0.8.18 alpha development release.
Uses the suite-owned rendering interfaces when receiving Flux Motion export jobs.

products.name: Flux Motion
products.description: Design broadcast graphics, titles and motion scenes in one focused workspace.

entries: Added Scene Mask source controls with joystick positioning, W-T zoom and optional numeric entry.
Added cover-style bounds enforcement so transformed scenes fully cover their masks without empty space.
Removed the redundant per-mask Crop when out of mask box setting.

products.name: Flux Motion Plugin for OBS
products.description: Cue and render Flux Motion projects directly inside OBS Studio.

entries: Added a compact Scene Masks dock with separate Preview and Monitor sections, joystick positioning and W-T zoom.
Added adjustable Smooth Motion for live transforms, Center and Reset.
Kept Preview-only nested videos stopped until Program activation and preserved configured OBS playback behavior.
Made dock shortcuts durable across plugin updates and kept active cues intact during source changes.
Applied optional cover-style bounds enforcement consistently from both the dock and source properties.
